User story: As a customer, I want to pay by UPI, card or cash on delivery, so that I can pay the way I prefer.
As a customer, I want to search products by name and get results even with small spelling mistakes, so that I find items quickly.
As a customer, I want to see whether an item is in stock at my nearest store, so that I don't order something that cannot be delivered.
As a customer, I want to choose a 2-hour delivery slot, so that someone is home when the order arrives.
As a customer, I want to browse products by category and sub-category, so that I can find what I need without typing.
As a customer, I want to add items to my cart and change quantities, so that I can build my order.
As a customer, I want to see my order status (packed, out for delivery, delivered), so that I know when to expect it.
As a customer, I want to report a missing or damaged item after delivery, so that I get a refund without calling the store.
As a customer, I want to filter results by price, brand and veg / non-veg, so that I narrow a long list to what suits me.
As a customer, I want to apply a coupon code to my cart, so that I get the advertised discount.
As a customer, I want to get a notification when my order is out for delivery, so that I can be ready at the door.
As a returning customer, I want to reorder a previous order in one tap, so that my weekly shopping takes a minute.
As a customer, I want to track the delivery partner live on a map, so that I know exactly how far away they are.
